summary.zh: 全部新聞列表新增文章縮圖與圖片署名，並配合手機版面調整排列；圖片缺少或載入失敗時顯示網站預設圖。
summary.en: Added article thumbnails and image credits to the All news index, with a mobile-friendly layout and a site image fallback when a photo is missing or fails to load.

summary.zh: 搜尋支援依公開署名的撰稿模型查找文章，可搭配新聞關鍵字與航空公司代碼縮小範圍，並辨識不同模型版本。
summary.en: Added article search by publicly credited writing model, with support for combining model names, news keywords and airline codes while distinguishing model versions.

summary.zh: 強化航空新聞範圍判定，將缺乏直接航空關聯的航運、物流與其他題材排除於撰稿及公開頁面，並撤下不符範圍的既有內容。
summary.en: Strengthened aviation scope checks to exclude shipping, logistics and other topics without a direct aviation connection from drafting and public pages, and withdrew existing out-of-scope content.

summary.zh: 事故資料庫改用響應式事件卡片，整合事件日期、航空器與地點等資訊，並提供更清楚的嚴重程度篩選及結果數量，改善手機與桌面瀏覽。
summary.en: Redesigned the incident database with responsive event cards that bring together dates, aircraft and locations, plus clearer severity filters and result counts for mobile and desktop browsing.

summary.zh: 強化自動撰稿的最後備援，為 GPT 6 保留獨立撰稿與修正時間；剩餘時間不足時保留新聞供後續重試，並維持來源與事實核驗要求。
summary.en: Strengthened the final drafting fallback by reserving independent drafting and repair time for GPT 6. Stories remain available for later retries when time is insufficient, with source and fact verification requirements preserved.

summary.zh: 完善既有文章與公開頁面的英文版本，涵蓋缺漏的文章內容、快報摘要、來源名稱、圖片說明及錯誤頁面，提升英文閱讀的一致性。
summary.en: Completed missing English content across existing articles and public pages, including article copy, briefing summaries, source names, image labels and error pages, for a more consistent English reading experience.

summary.zh: 每日提供晨間、午後與晚間航空快報，涵蓋飛安、臺灣航空及國際產業，支援依日期與時段瀏覽；改善中文標題的主體、動作與結果表達，導覽標示 BETA。
summary.en: Added morning, afternoon and evening aviation briefings covering safety, Taiwan aviation and international industry, browsable by date and edition. Improved Chinese headline clarity and added a BETA navigation label.

summary.zh: 將首頁頭條輪播間隔調整為 2.5 秒，並保留手動切換及游標／鍵盤焦點暫停功能。
summary.en: Set the homepage headline carousel to advance every 2.5 seconds while keeping manual controls and hover/focus pause behavior.

summary.zh: 文章署名新增 DeepSeek V4 Flash 顯示名稱，讓讀者能辨識實際使用的撰稿模型。
summary.en: Added DeepSeek V4 Flash to article bylines so readers can identify the actual drafting model used.

summary.zh: 新增 OpenAI GPT 6 與 MAX 推理支援，納入自動撰稿及手動選用模型，並使用結構化輸出與用量紀錄。
summary.en: Added OpenAI GPT 6 with MAX reasoning to automatic drafting and the manual model catalog, with structured output and usage tracking.

summary.zh: 新聞列表統一依文章發布時間排序，來源時間另行標示，頭條仍保留於最新新聞列表；加入跨執行週期的重試上限與等待間隔，避免失敗舊稿反覆擠壓新稿。
summary.en: Aligned news lists with article publication time, displayed source times separately and retained headlines in the latest-news feed. Added persistent retry limits and cooling intervals so failed older drafts do not crowd out new stories.

summary.zh: 在中英文共用網站導覽新增「全部新聞」入口，讓讀者可直接開啟完整新聞列表。
summary.en: Added an All news link to the shared English and Chinese site navigation for direct access to the full news index.

summary.zh: 加入文章資料讀取邊界的向後相容正規化，讓歷史文章缺少後來新增的選填欄位時仍可安全建置；同時新增建置失敗安全門檻，當頁面渲染錯誤超過 5 頁或 1% 時停止發布，避免將大範圍殘缺版本部署至正式網站。
summary.en: Added backward-compatible article normalization at the build read boundary so historical stories remain renderable when newer optional fields are absent. Also added a build safety budget that blocks publication when render failures exceed five pages or 1%, preventing broadly incomplete site versions from reaching production.

summary.zh: 將雷達與手動新聞的建置階段從 GitHub Pages 共用發布佇列中分離，只有最後部署階段需要排隊；雷達資料來源暫時無回應時保留上一份成功快照並略過部署，另為模型供應商加入跨執行週期的冷卻機制，降低重複逾時、額度耗盡與驗證失敗造成的連鎖影響。
summary.en: Decoupled radar and manual-news builds from the shared GitHub Pages publication queue so only final deployment is serialized. Temporary radar-source outages now keep the last successful snapshot and skip deployment, while persistent provider cooldowns reduce repeated timeouts, quota exhaustion and authentication failures across runs.

summary.zh: 限制單次模型撰稿嘗試為 180 秒、每輪一般新聞撰稿為 15 分鐘，時間用盡時儲存已完成稿件並保留其他新聞供後續重試，減少模型故障阻塞發布的時間。
summary.en: Limited each drafting attempt to 180 seconds and each regular news drafting run to 15 minutes. Completed drafts are saved when the budget expires, while remaining stories stay available for retries.

summary.zh: 恢復星宇與美國航空聯營及越航慕尼黑事故期中報告的來源輸入，保留原始發布日期與既有去重、來源及事實核驗規則；調整故障模型的備援順序，減少反覆逾時。
summary.en: Recovered source inputs for the STARLUX–American codeshare and Vietnam Airlines Munich interim report while preserving original dates, deduplication and verification rules. Adjusted model fallback order to reduce repeated timeouts.

summary.zh: 將每小時新聞抓取排程移至第 45 分鐘，降低整點附近排程壅塞造成延遲的風險。
summary.en: Moved hourly news collection to minute 45 to reduce scheduling delays around the top of the hour.

summary.zh: 加強文章事實與原始來源的對應，檢查明確日期、時間、數量及航空技術識別資訊，並要求新增的結構化實體附來源網址與原文引述，適用於自動及手動撰稿。
summary.en: Strengthened source binding for explicit dates, times, counts and aviation technical identifiers. New structured entities must carry a source URL and verbatim supporting quote, for both automatic and manually initiated drafting.

summary.zh: 雷達來源暫時沒有航機資料時，新聞及快報網站仍可完成發布，且不產生空白雷達快照；獨立雷達更新仍會回報來源異常。
summary.en: Allowed news and briefing deployments to finish when radar data is temporarily unavailable without producing an empty snapshot. Independent radar updates still report source failures.

summary.zh: 啟用每日早、中、晚快報的搜尋補充與總覽，依事件內容分類並產生章節導言；搜尋新聞須有該期時間範圍內的來源發布時間，頁面列出實際引用的去重來源連結。
summary.en: Enabled search supplementation and overviews for morning, afternoon and evening briefings, with event-based categorization and section introductions. Search items require source timestamps within the issue window, and pages list deduplicated cited sources.

summary.zh: 事故資料庫支援有來源依據的軍用與其他國家航空器事件，不再限制文章必須歸入飛安分類，並更新資料庫涵蓋範圍與分級說明。
summary.en: Allowed source-supported military and other state-aircraft events in the incident database regardless of article category, and clarified its scope and classification notes.

summary.zh: 發布前檢查文章、摘要、快訊與事故欄位的繁體中文，避免簡體字出現在公開內容，並修正既有文章與晨間快報的標題及摘要。
summary.en: Added pre-publication Traditional Chinese checks for article copy, summaries, flashes and incident fields, and corrected affected titles and summaries in existing articles and a morning briefing.

summary.zh: 將 14 篇歷史文章的 Google News 轉址來源恢復為可直接開啟的官方或媒體網址，並加入全歷史文章來源檢查，確保未封存文章至少有一個直接來源。
summary.en: Restored direct official or media source URLs for 14 historical articles that only had Google News redirects, and added archive-wide checks requiring at least one direct source for every active article.

summary.zh: 擴充合併前回歸檢查，涵蓋航機追蹤、機場代碼、來源擷取、事實查證、快報與圖片等既有測試，並讓測試檔案變更也觸發檢查。
summary.en: Expanded pre-merge regression coverage for flight tracking, airport codes, source extraction, fact checking, briefings and images, and made test-file changes trigger regression checks.

summary.zh: 航機追蹤的主要來源失敗時改用備援來源，依實際使用的來源標示觀測資料，避免把同一來源重複查詢視為獨立交叉驗證，並擴充機場名稱辨識。
summary.en: Added a fallback source for aircraft tracking, labeled observations by the source actually used, prevented repeated queries to one provider from counting as independent corroboration, and expanded airport-name recognition.

summary.zh: 改善首頁即時快訊左欄排版，固定時間與標題欄位，將長標題限制為兩行並以省略號收尾，避免置頂標籤或長文字擠壓造成列高不一致。
summary.en: Improved the homepage live-news rail with fixed time and headline columns, two-line truncation for long headlines, and stable spacing when priority labels are present.

summary.zh: 搜尋新增航空公司 IATA／ICAO 代碼辨識，以結構化航空公司實體限定結果，並將 1 至 3 字元的英數搜尋改為完整詞匹配，避免 DE 等短代碼誤中一般單字。
summary.en: Added airline IATA/ICAO code recognition to search, restricting results through structured airline identities and requiring whole-token matches for one-to-three-character Latin searches so short codes such as DE cannot match ordinary words.

summary.zh: 修正每日搜尋推薦與文章索引不同步，讓推薦詞精確連結來源文章、隔日仍可查找，空白送出可套用目前提示；並改善航空公司品牌及中英文同義詞辨識。
summary.en: Kept daily search suggestions aligned with indexed source articles and searchable after rotation, applied the current suggestion on empty submissions, and improved airline-brand and bilingual synonym matching.

summary.zh: 首頁加入臺灣焦點頭條輪播，優先呈現臺灣相關航空新聞，並提供 8 秒自動輪播、左右切換、暫停與無障礙控制。
summary.en: Added a Taiwan-focused headline carousel to the homepage, prioritizing Taiwan-related aviation news with eight-second autoplay, previous/next controls, pause support and accessible controls.

summary.zh: 將公開介面、歷史文章、圖片署名與專案連結中的 AVWIRE 統一改為 SKYTICAL，並更新舊版資產網址。
summary.en: Unified the public interface, historical articles, image credits and project links under SKYTICAL, while updating legacy asset URLs.

summary.zh: 修正 iPad 直式首頁偶發採用桌面版排列的問題，固定先顯示頭條，再顯示即時快訊與來源狀態，並同步調整導覽列斷點。
summary.en: Fixed an iPad portrait layout issue that could apply desktop ordering, keeping the lead story before the live ticker and source status while aligning the navigation breakpoint.

summary.zh: 改善航空新聞配圖，支援有署名的 AeroTime 事件照片、註冊號與貨機子型號核對，並依航空公司機隊角色選擇高解析度實機照；修正誤配機型並保留拒絕原因。
summary.en: Improved news imagery with credited AeroTime event photos, registration and freighter-subtype checks, and high-resolution photos chosen for each airline's fleet role. Corrected mismatched types and retained rejection reasons.

summary.zh: 首頁全球延誤與取消改為連結至 FlightAware 公開即時統計，移除未設定來源提示。
summary.en: Replaced unavailable homepage disruption totals with a link to FlightAware's public live statistics.

summary.zh: 新聞圖片顯示可驗證的主體描述並保留原始圖說；缺少可信描述時使用已標示的網站預設圖。
summary.en: Added verified image-subject descriptions and original captions, with a labelled site fallback when reliable descriptions are unavailable.

summary.zh: 改善 iPhone 頁首標誌載入與即時快訊顯示，調整文字、時間的字級及字重，避免短暫留白和文字溢出。
summary.en: Improved iPhone logo loading and live updates, adjusting story and time typography to prevent blank flashes and text overflow.

summary.zh: 移除自動撰稿中持續失效的模型路由，減少重複失敗請求造成的更新延遲。
summary.en: Removed persistently failing automatic drafting routes to reduce update delays from repeated failed requests.

summary.zh: 早、午、晚快報各自提供完整過去 24 小時匯總，並將臺灣航空分為民航與軍航。
summary.en: Made each morning, afternoon and evening briefing a complete 24-hour digest, with separate Taiwan civil and military aviation sections.

summary.zh: 加入導覽路徑結構化資料，改善網站地圖更新日期、文章作者及社群分享資訊。
summary.en: Added breadcrumb structured data and improved sitemap modification dates, article authorship and social-sharing metadata.

summary.zh: 改善 iPad 直式導覽、首頁閱讀順序與雷達單欄排列，避免頁面橫向溢位。
summary.en: Improved portrait iPad navigation, homepage reading order and single-column radar layout without horizontal overflow.

summary.zh: 新增中英文新聞索引、分頁與 RSS，延後載入搜尋索引，並強化機場代碼、新聞主題、近期配圖及原始來源連結檢查。
summary.en: Added bilingual paginated news indexes and RSS, deferred search-index loading, and strengthened airport-code, topic, recent-image and original-source-link checks.

summary.zh: 首頁可輪播符合條件的天氣與國籍航空航班異動新聞，每五分鐘切換。
summary.en: Added five-minute homepage rotation for qualifying weather-related national-airline flight-change stories.

summary.zh: 首頁本週嚴重事件可連到相同統計範圍的事故清單，再開啟完整新聞。
summary.en: Linked the homepage weekly serious-event count to the matching incident list and full articles.

summary.zh: 擴大首頁與主題頁新聞摘要的可用寬度，改善桌面版提早換行。
summary.en: Expanded summary width on home and topic pages to reduce premature desktop line wrapping.

summary.zh: 頁首與頁尾統一使用核准的 SKYTICAL 標誌母版，移除額外重描的翼形疊圖。
summary.en: Restored the approved SKYTICAL logo master in headers and footers and removed the redrawn wing overlay.

summary.zh: 配圖搜尋擴充至全球已辨識機場，保留授權與主題檢查及網站預設圖。
summary.en: Extended image search to identified airports worldwide while retaining licence, relevance and site-fallback checks.

summary.zh: 正式網站啟用 skytical.tech，同步更新中英文網址、網站地圖與搜尋分享資訊。
summary.en: Launched skytical.tech and updated bilingual URLs, sitemaps and search and sharing metadata.

summary.zh: 網站品牌更新為 SKYTICAL，套用彩色標誌、「SKYLINE TO AVIATION NEWS」標語、頁首頁尾、網站圖示與社群分享圖片。
summary.en: Rebranded the site as SKYTICAL with its color logo, “SKYLINE TO AVIATION NEWS” tagline, header and footer branding, site icons and social sharing images.

summary.zh: 新增航空主題頁、編輯與更正政策、網站地圖及新聞結構化資料，改善搜尋收錄。
summary.en: Added aviation topic pages, editorial and correction policies, sitemaps and news structured data for search discovery.

summary.zh: 新聞摘要改為只顯示於首頁，內頁保留正文與搜尋引擎描述。
summary.en: Limited visible news summaries to the homepage while retaining article text and search metadata.

summary.zh: 首頁加入 Apple 風格重點摘要，快速呈現航空公司、地點、時間與影響。
summary.en: Added Apple-style homepage summaries covering the operator, place, time and impact at a glance.

summary.zh: 全站頁首加入新聞搜尋欄，支援航空公司簡稱與正式名稱別名、每日新聞搜尋提示，並在從結果開啟文章時短暫標示關鍵字與別名。
summary.en: Added site-wide header search with airline aliases and daily news suggestions, plus temporary keyword and alias highlighting when opening articles from results.

summary.zh: 新聞文末顯示實際使用的撰稿模型。
summary.en: Added the actual drafting model used to each article footer.

summary.zh: 改善 iPhone 響應式版面、導覽及新聞列表，並調整手機 LIVE 快訊的字級與捲動速度。
summary.en: Improved iPhone layout, navigation and news lists, along with mobile LIVE ticker typography and scrolling speed.

summary.zh: 擴充航空新聞來源，加入 Aerospace Global News、AeroTime，以及飛機與發動機製造商官方消息。
summary.en: Expanded aviation sources with Aerospace Global News, AeroTime, and official aircraft and engine manufacturer news.

summary.zh: 撰稿系統升級為多供應商模型與編輯驗證引擎，加入模型優先順序、品質及分級推理設定、備援路由與可觀測性。
summary.en: Upgraded drafting to a multi-provider model and editorial verification engine with model priorities, quality and reasoning profiles, failover routing and observability.

summary.zh: 新增雙語網站更新紀錄頁與全站頁尾入口
summary.en: Added a bilingual site changelog and a footer entry point on every page

summary.zh: 撰稿流程加入可追溯的受控歷史脈絡與短訊降級
summary.en: Added traceable verified historical context and controlled brief fallback to drafting

summary.zh: 新增臺灣民航 ADS-B 航班雷達，支援 ICAO／IATA 呼號切換與起迄航點。
summary.en: Added Taiwan civil ADS-B radar with ICAO/IATA callsign switching and origin-destination routes.

summary.zh: 新增軍事新聞分類與前端標籤
summary.en: Added the military news category and front-end label

summary.zh: 新增依臺北時段每日三次的航空與交通快報，採用獨立條列版型，納入臺灣軍事航空與交通來源，不再直接重複正式新聞。
summary.en: Added three daily air-and-transport briefings on Taipei time, using standalone bulletins with Taiwan military aviation and transport sources rather than mirroring full articles.

summary.zh: 首頁即時快訊列可直接開啟對應新聞
summary.en: Linked each homepage live-update item directly to its corresponding story

summary.zh: 新增內容完整性檢查，並對證據不足的衍生報導採取保守處理
summary.en: Added content-integrity checks and conservative handling for derivative reports with insufficient evidence

summary.zh: 加入臺灣特殊航機抵達偵測與來源文字正規化，觀測經自動規則驗證後可直接發布。
summary.en: Added Taiwan special-aircraft arrival detection and source-text normalization, with direct publication after automated observation checks.

summary.zh: 新聞影像改為完整比例、全彩顯示並標示影像主體
summary.en: Changed news imagery to full-frame colour display with subject labels

summary.zh: 透過無須第三方 API 憑證的公開資料來源，自動配對具再利用授權的新聞影像
summary.en: Added automated matching of reusable news imagery through public sources that require no third-party API credentials

summary.zh: 文章文末開始標示實際撰稿模型
summary.en: Started crediting the actual drafting model in article footers

summary.zh: 網站改為置中 1280px 內容版面與側邊留白
summary.en: Changed the site to a centred 1280px content sheet with side gutters

summary.zh: 建立 SKYTICAL：抓取、去重、撰稿、建置管線與每小時自動部署
summary.en: Created SKYTICAL with fetch, dedupe, drafting, build and hourly deployment pipelines

summary.zh: 在搜尋欄旁新增 SKYTICAL 官方 Facebook 與 Instagram 連結，讓讀者可直接前往官方社群。
summary.en: Added official SKYTICAL Facebook and Instagram links beside the search bar for direct access to the site's social channels.

summary.zh: 新增 SKYTICAL 團隊頁，以中英文介紹創辦人 neo 與網站的建立初衷。
summary.en: Added a bilingual SKYTICAL team page introducing founder neo and the story behind the site.

summary.zh: 擴充日文航空安全新聞的來源探索與原文連結解析；來源連續三次成功抓取仍沒有可用內容時，現在會發出檢查提醒。
summary.en: Expanded discovery and publisher-link resolution for Japanese aviation safety news, and added an alert when a source returns no usable items across three consecutive successful fetches.

summary.zh: 更新 About SKYTICAL 方法介紹頁，以來源至文章的流程圖呈現新聞如何整理、查證與編輯成稿。
summary.en: Redesigned the About SKYTICAL methodology page with a source-to-story diagram showing how news is gathered, verified and edited.

summary.zh: 首頁側欄新增臺灣航空焦點與航空主題連結，方便讀者瀏覽臺灣航空新聞並前往主題頁。
summary.en: Added a Taiwan aviation focus and aviation topic links to the homepage sidebar, making it easier to browse Taiwan aviation news and topic pages.

summary.zh: 將僅談衛星軌道事件或彈頭製造、未涉及實際航空運作的內容移出公開頁面，並加強範圍檢查以避免同類題材再次刊出。
summary.en: Removed satellite-orbit and warhead-production stories without a direct aviation connection from public pages and strengthened scope checks against similar off-topic coverage.

summary.zh: 搜尋現在能處理中英文及航班號混合查詢，正確辨識中英交界並比對中文詞組。
summary.en: Search now handles mixed Chinese, English and flight-number queries by recognizing script boundaries and matching Chinese phrases.

summary.zh: 統一中文排版，移除中文字間及中英文或數字交界處多餘空格，保留英文單字與中文句子之間的間距。
summary.en: Standardized Chinese typography by removing excess character and Chinese-Latin spacing while preserving spaces between English words and Chinese sentences.

summary.zh: 統一中英文文章的公開網址與中繼資料，讓站內連結、搜尋、RSS、網站地圖及分享資訊使用一致的標準網址。
summary.en: Standardized public article URLs and bilingual metadata so internal links, search, RSS, sitemaps and sharing use the same canonical URL.

summary.zh: 新增「專欄報導」文章分類與公開分類篩選，讓主題介紹、解說及回顧文章與事件報導更容易區分。
summary.en: Added a Feature article category and public category filters to distinguish explainers and retrospectives from reports centered on current events.

summary.zh: 航機雷達改為地圖優先介面，採用易辨識的航機剪影與黃色標記；選取航機後依完整 ICAO hex 顯示實機照片、攝影署名及來源，無相符照片時明確標示。
summary.en: Redesigned radar around the map with recognizable aircraft silhouettes and yellow markers. Aircraft selections show photos matched by full ICAO hex, credits and sources, with a clear unavailable state when no exact photo exists.

summary.zh: 首頁與全站快訊列現在為舊快訊顯示臺北日期，並讓輪播複本不再重複出現在鍵盤與螢幕閱讀器導覽中。
summary.en: The homepage and site-wide flash feed now show Taipei-local dates for older alerts, while carousel duplicates are hidden from keyboard and screen-reader navigation.

summary.zh: 改善手機首頁瀏覽：新聞列表加入文章縮圖與圖片署名，手機版隱藏來源狀態區塊，並提供雙列分類篩選及可滑動的頭條輪播。
summary.en: Improved mobile homepage browsing with article thumbnails and image credits, a hidden mobile source-status block, a two-row category filter and swipeable headlines.

summary.zh: 頁首與團隊頁新增翼標飛行動畫，並修正動畫殘影、短螢幕進場播放與 Mac Safari 黑底，保留原有色彩、連結、觸控操作及減少動態設定。
summary.en: Added wing-mark flight animations to the header and team page, fixing trails, playback on short screens and black backgrounds in Mac Safari while preserving colors, links, touch controls and reduced-motion support.

summary.zh: 手機版頁首整合品牌標誌、搜尋與社群連結，並固定顯示六項主要導覽；平板選單與桌面導覽維持既有操作方式。
summary.en: Combined the brand logo, search and social links in a compact mobile header, with six primary links always visible while retaining tablet-menu and desktop navigation behavior.

summary.zh: 精簡公開提交紀錄，只保留雙語摘要、日期與變更統計，避免顯示非必要的作者與設定欄位。
summary.en: Simplified public commit records to retain bilingual summaries, dates and change statistics without displaying nonessential author or configuration fields.

summary.zh: 修正首頁過期置頂文章擠滿頭條的問題，將輪播擴增為八則，最多保留一則發布未滿48小時的置頂內容，並精簡卡片資訊。
summary.en: Fixed stale pinned stories crowding out recent headlines, expanded the carousel to eight stories, limited pinned items to one published within 48 hours, and simplified card details.

summary.zh: 修正一般標誌與翼標在 Safari 縮小顯示時的遮罩邊緣，改用保留原始色彩與透明度的圖像；手機搜尋欄恢復每日搜尋提示詞。
summary.en: Fixed Safari logo and wing-mark mask edges using images that preserve original colors and transparency, and restored daily search suggestions in the mobile search bar.

summary.zh: 手機版統一桌面深淺色色票，精簡標誌、搜尋與選單列；頭條採上圖下文，新聞以橫線分隔，調整分類列與快訊速度，改善閱讀密度。
summary.en: Unified mobile and desktop light/dark palettes, simplified the logo, search and menu row, and refined image-first headlines, news dividers, category controls and ticker speed for denser mobile reading.

summary.zh: 新聞配圖加入 GPT 6.1 輔助搜尋與視覺核對，僅採用授權及主題符合要求的 Commons 候選，保留作者、授權與來源；排除未取得再利用授權的中央社照片，無合適圖片時使用網站預設圖。
summary.en: Added GPT 6.1-assisted Commons image discovery and visual review, requiring suitable licensing and relevance while preserving authors, licenses and sources. Excluded CNA photos without reuse permission and retained the site fallback when no suitable image is available.

summary.zh: 持續為近期航空新聞與短訊彙整加入經核對的真實照片，修正錯公司、錯機型與不適切配圖；資料照標明年份及與事件的關係，彙整圖說明所代表的消息，保留署名、來源及編輯鎖定。
summary.en: Added reviewed real photos to recent news and roundups, corrected mismatched airlines, aircraft and unsuitable selections, and labeled archive years, event context and the represented roundup item while preserving credits, sources and editorial locks.

summary.zh: 新聞卡片改用精簡且完整的摘要句，優先一個句子、最多三句，避免直接重複標題或截斷數字與機型；保留原始摘要並維持頭條輪播高度穩定。
summary.en: News cards now favor one concise complete summary sentence, with up to three where needed, without repeating headlines or cutting numbers and aircraft names. Original summaries and stable carousel height are preserved.

summary.zh: 強化中英文機場代碼保留：以來源明示且經資料庫核對的機場名稱與 IATA 配對供撰稿及發布檢查共用，修正漏標與錯配，僅有城市名時不推測機場。
summary.en: Preserved source-confirmed, registry-checked airport names and IATA codes across bilingual drafting and publication checks, corrected missing and mismatched codes, and avoided inferring airports from city names alone.

summary.zh: 改善 GPT 6 撰稿、搜尋及核驗的備援流程，移除造成完整回覆中斷的本機處理期限與輸出限制，保留來源查證、有限修正次數及用量控管。
summary.en: Improved GPT 6 fallback drafting, search and verification by removing local processing deadlines and output limits that interrupted complete responses, while retaining source checks, bounded repairs and usage controls.

summary.zh: 新增航空短訊彙整，將符合條件的兩至八則例行消息集中呈現並佔用一格頭條；各則分開標題與段落，保留原始來源、既有文章及實際撰稿模型署名，臺灣、飛安與重大消息維持獨立報導。
summary.en: Added aviation roundups that combine two to eight eligible routine updates into one headline slot, with separate headings and paragraphs, original sources, existing articles and actual model credits. Taiwan, safety and major news remain standalone.

summary.zh: 為歷史航空新聞補充可追溯的真實照片，撤換原創新聞示意圖與誤配圖片；優先選用事件、同公司或相符機隊資料照，明確區分非事件現場照片，無可信照片時保留預設圖。
summary.en: Backfilled historical aviation news with traceable real photographs, replacing original illustrations and mismatched images. Preferred event or matching company/fleet photos, clearly labeled archive context, and retained the fallback where no trustworthy photo was available.

summary.zh: 修正每日快報在共用用量資料更新後無法儲存的問題，隔離提交流程並保存已生成內容，避免並行更新造成快報遺失。
summary.en: Fixed daily briefings failing to persist after shared usage updates by isolating commits and preserving generated content against concurrent changes.

summary.zh: 強化 GPT 6 備援與編輯核驗，優先處理臺灣、飛安及監管消息，為一般新聞加入抽樣複核，修正後須再次通過來源與事實檢查。
summary.en: Strengthened GPT 6 fallback and editorial verification, prioritizing Taiwan, safety and regulatory stories, sampling ordinary news for review, and requiring repaired drafts to pass source and fact checks again.

summary.zh: 新增每四小時執行的中英文機場 IATA 代碼核對，檢查標題及內文首次提及的機場，記錄缺漏與衝突供後續修正。
summary.en: Added four-hourly bilingual airport IATA audits that check first mentions in headlines and body text and record omissions or conflicts for correction.

summary.zh: 修正機場 IATA 代碼漏標與錯配，避免依跨語言順序或單一機場推測配對；配圖優先檢查文章所引官方航空公司及機場頁面，保留相關性、來源與資料照標示。
summary.en: Corrected missing and mismatched airport IATA codes without inferring identities from cross-language order or a single airport. Image lookup now prioritizes cited official airline and airport pages while retaining relevance, attribution and archive labels.

summary.zh: 新增搜尋探索航空新聞來源，候選網址須獨立抓取原文與發布時間並通過既有查證；同一出版者沿用既有來源識別，避免重複計算獨立來源。
summary.en: Added search-based aviation source discovery, requiring independently fetched original text and publication dates plus existing verification. Reused publisher identities to avoid counting the same outlet as independent sources.

summary.zh: 校正西雪梨國際機場（WSI）啟用報導的雙語標題、航班、容量與時程，保留原網址及發布時間，撤下重複矛盾內容，並加強官方來源綁定與發布前檢查。
summary.en: Corrected bilingual Western Sydney International Airport (WSI) opening coverage, including flight, capacity and timeline details, while preserving its URL and publication time. Removed contradictory duplicate coverage and strengthened official-source binding and prepublication checks.
